_source: rsprox recording 3886 (rev 235): Set Destination and Teleport to Destination at the level 13 obelisk. OSRS Wiki: Wilderness_Obelisk. The obelisks' south-west corner stones and ids come from the cache map; `corner` is the south-west stone, the others are 4 tiles east, north and north-east, and the pad is the 3x3 between them.

menu._recorded: Menu 187 through script 217 with these args; the pause button's sub is the obelisk, and the varbit takes sub + 1.
menu.title: Select Obelisk destination

_timeline: Recorded, in ticks after the click: the stones glow and synth 204 plays four times (delay 10) at once; the smokepuff and area sound at 7; the stones back at 10; the portal on the pad's nine tiles at 11; the teleport at 13.

messages._recorded: chosen: recorded (a set destination). random: the Wiki's arrival line.
messages.chosen: Ancient magic teleports you to a place within the wilderness!
messages.random: Ancient magic teleports you somewhere in the Wilderness!
messages._calibrated: No source gives these: the refusals without the hard diary or a set destination.
messages.needsDiary: You need to complete the hard Wilderness Diary to choose an obelisk's destination.
messages.noDestination: You haven't set a destination yet.

house._source: rsprox recording 2884 (rev 230), the superior garden's obelisk: Activate answered at tick 5907; Set destination at 6165, then Teleport to destination at 6172, answered at 6178. OSRS Wiki, Obelisk_(Construction): it individually teleports players, to a random obelisk without the hard Wilderness Diary.
house._warning: Recorded before every teleport: varbit cws_warning_id 7, then the modal with its 'Don't ask me this again' toggle hidden and this text. 'Enter Wilderness' resumes sub 1 and 'Don't go' sub 0 (clientscript 1437).

warning.text:
The obelisk will teleport you into the Wilderness.

Do you really wish to go there?

house._teleport: Recorded on 'Enter Wilderness': seq human_wilderness_portal at once, and 2 ticks later the arrival line (the chosen one, for Activate too), the teleport to a tile of the obelisk's pad and seq -1. Activate landed on the level 44 pad (2980,3867) with level 35 set; Teleport to destination on the set level 13 pad (3157,3619).
